(319)༄༅/ /snyan brgyud rde'u bcud len dang me tog bcud len gyi 'don khrid sbrags ma bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (319)༄༅// snyan brgyud rde'u bcud len dang me tog bcud len gyi 'don khrid sbrags ma bzhugs so//

(320)༄༅// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus kyis bdag gces 'dzin dang*/ 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med par mkhyen te/ 'jig rten chos brgyad dang tshe 'di'i bde skyid thams cad blos ling btang*/ log 'tsho dkor zas sgrub pa bzang ngan gyi 'dzin pa kun bor te dben pa'i ri la gang byung chog shes ci byung lam khyer na nus 'chi nus kyi byang chub lam chen la bzhud pa'i gshegs shul/ chos sku kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po// sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro mandā ra ba'am ni gu ma zhes sku gcig mtshan gnyis kyi rnam grangs du mar 'bod pa de nyid kyis/ 'jigs bral dus gsum rnam mkhyen la snyan brgyud du bstsal ba'i dka' thub rde'u bcud len gyi gdams pa bstan pa la/ rdo brtag pa dang gcig /thu ba dang gnyis/ byin gyis brlab pa dang gsum/ za thabs dang bzhi/ dam tshig dang lnga/ gegs sel dang drug /yon tan dang bdun/ khungs bstan pa dang brgyad las/ (321)dang po rdo brtag pa ni/ rdo rigs lnga ste/ sha chen tshil chen gnyis/ rus pa can/ mkhris pa can gnyis/ shi sha can dang lnga las/ sha chen ni mdog gang yang rung la so mi brtse zhing sha chen nyams can/ tshil chen ni dkar la tshil bu'i rnam pa yod pa/ rus can ni/ dkar sgong dang me rdo lta bu/ mkhris pa can ni g.ya' ma dang ljang gu chu rdo'i rigs so// shi sha can ni rdo phal pa rnams so// bsten pa ni sha tshil can bsten cing*/ gzhan rnams spang bya'o// de nas rdo thu ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig par bskyed/ sor mo rnams mkha' 'gro lngar bsgom/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ rdo bdud rtsir bsams la sngags 'di bzlas la thu'o// oṃ trig yer trig yer swā hā// zhes bzla zhing mdun du bsag /de nas rtsa gsum mchog gsum skyabs yul thams cad bstims la snod du blugs/

rdo thu ba'i thabs yin/ de nas byin rlabs bya ba'i thog mar zangs (322)dkar g.ya' can nam/ rdza gang rigs kyi snod du/ sman bzang drug la sogs pas btsos/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs la byin gyi brlab pa ni/ rde'u rnams ka pā la'i nang du blugs/ skyabs sems spyi mthun rjes/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ snang srid chos kun 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang*// rang nyid skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// spyan gsum cung zad zhi khro'i nyams dang ldan// phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa// sha lnga bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin// rin chen rus rgyan gru mor kha ṭām̐ 'chang*// rna ltag g.yas na phag zhal ngur sgra sgrogs// thod skam dbu rgyan rlon pa'i do shal can// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pad nyi ro gdan bzhugs// me dpung 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs// de yi dbu gtsug rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams// 'ja' 'od klong na tho brtsegs tshul du bzhugs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod la/ rde'u rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar mos la/ byin gyi rlob pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ mu le mu le ma hā mu le swā hā/ zhes brgya stong bzlas la phu gdab/ bgegs bsal gyi sngags ni/ oṃ sha pa tri shi shag shig swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas te rde'u la 'debs/ bza' thabs ni/ dang po yar dkar mthe bong tsam re rde'u'i snga phyir btang*/ rjes su ma byung yang rung*/ ja chang skyo tsha gang rigs phor tshad re tsam gyis bul te mid rjes gsol 'debs ni/ na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī bhyaḥ /chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku pad 'byung mkha' 'gro ni gu mar// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'byung ba rdo yi bcud mchog lon pa dang*// bcud len mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum rnam mkhyen phyogs las rnam rgyal la// (323)gsol ba=

/'byung ba= /bcud len= /ras chen chos rje sangs rgyas bzang mo la/ gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /rin chen rgyal po 'jam dbyangs padma gar/ gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud= /grags pa 'od zer rab 'byams chos kyi rje// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud= /ratna'i mtshan can 'dus chen rab rgyas la/ gsol= /'byung = /bcud= /'jam dbyangs dga' ba rin chen bzang po la// gsol ba= /'byung = /bcud= /'jigs med rnam rgyal 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la// gsol= /'byung = /bcud= /rig 'dzin rnam rgyal bde chen mtsho mo la/ gsol= /'byung = /bcud= /tshul khrims rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol= /'byung = /bcud= /yi dam mkha' 'gro bkra shis 'od 'bar la/ gsol= /'byung= /bcud= /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i spun grogs la// gsol= /'byung = /bcud= /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu longs sku thugs rje chen po la thim/ longs sku thugs rje chen po sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la thim/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ni gu ma la= /ni gu ma 'jigs med grags pa= /'jigs med grags pa dpal 'byor bzang po la= /ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po yang 'od du zhu ḍā ki ma sangs rgyas bzang mo= /sangs rgyas bzang mo yang = /mkhas grub rin chen rgyal po la= /mkhas grub chen po= /'jam dbyangs padma gar dbang la= /'jam dbyangs padma gar dbang yang = /rje btsun grags pa 'od zer la= /grags pa 'od zer yang = /rab 'byams chos rje la= /rab 'byams chos rje yang = /ratna'i mtshan can la= /ratna'i mtshan can yang = /'dus chen rab rgyas la= /'dus chen rab rgyas yang = /'jam dbyangs dga' ba la= /'jam dbyangs dga' ba (324)yang = /bka' drin 'khor med rin chen bzang po la= /rin chen bzang po yang = /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'jigs med rnam rgyal la= /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor yang = /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la= 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal yang =

/rig 'dzin rnam rgyal la= rig 'dzin rnam rgyal yang 'od du zhu chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mo la= /chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mo yang = /thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims rdo rje la thim/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims rdo rje yang 'od du zhu/ bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer ma mchis pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu thob/ sems gzung 'dzin dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag go /'di'i dam tshig la/ rdo byin gyis ma brlabs pa dang*/ yi dam ma bsgoms par mi bza'/ gzhan la gsang zhing nyams grib la 'dzem/ zas nor gsog 'jog mi bya tshogs su gtang*/ thig le nyams su mi 'jug /sngags 'dren skabs ngag mi gtong*/ gegs sel ni/ 'di nyams su len pa'i dus su tshe 'di blos mi thong ba dang*/ bza' snying mi 'dod pa dang*/ dka' thub kyi dam bca' blos gtong bar 'dod pa byung na/ gegs dang bar chad du shes par byas la/ na shi ltog rgyags ci byung rung*/ 'dis mgo thon pa mi bya re snyam pa'i blo shed bskyed/ des gegs mi 'ong*/ gal te byung na sel thabs chu bskol la mar btab nas 'thung*/ skyug na chu dron gtang*/ 'byams na skyo tsha gtang*/ rlung la rlung sman bsten/ des gegs sel lo// 'di'i yon tan la rdo bza' ba'i dus su yog tshad zos pas chog /lto gos kyi rtsol ba chad/ zhag bdun brgyad nas kyis sha bri/ dri chung*/ zhag bcu nas shed dang*/ sha dwangs skye la/ shes pa dang dbang po gsal/ dge sbyor la bogs thon/ rdo (325)la ro mchog thon/ lus yang zhing mgyogs/ srog chags mi 'byung*/ drod skye/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin gyis rlob/ dpa' bo dang ḍā ki 'du/ chos skyong dang lha srin bran du 'gyur// zas nor dang longs spyod 'du/

mngon shes dang 'od gsal gyi nyams skye/ dge sbyor la brtan pa thob/ ser sna dang chags pa'i dri ma dag /phyi ma mu ge'i bskal pa las thar ba sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo*// rdo'i 'byung khungs bstan pa ni/ spa gro stag tshang*/ chu bo ri'i nub dang byang*/ phag mo gru/ gzho stod ti gro brag dkar/ lho brag mkhar chu gzad kyi bye ma lung sogs la yod do// bdud rtsi rdo'i bcud len gyi gdams ngag gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa rdzogs so// zhes pa me tog bcud len gyi zin bris dang chabs cig rang slob rnams kyis nyams su len pa'i ched du chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mos yi ger spel ba'o// ༈ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal de kho na nyid 'dus pa'i lugs ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas 'jigs bral dus gsum rnam mkhyen la snyan brgyud du gdams pa'i dka' thub me tog bcud len gyi gdams pa la don gsum/ sngon 'gro// dngos gzhi/ rjes phan yon bstan pa'o// de la dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa la/ me tog thu ba ni/ skyabs sems sngon du gtang*/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo dkar mo'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i sgo nas snying po bzla bzhin du sa gtsang sa me tog sna tshogs skye ba'i sa'i char kha shar du bltas te dug rigs med pa'i rtsi shing gang yang rung ba'i me tog rnams phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gi mgul pa nas bcad phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa'i nang du blugs par bsams la bsdus te/ de rnams rul sum med pa'i grib skam du byas pa cha (326)gnyis/ dug rigs med pa'i sman sna tshogs kyis cha gcig ste/ de yang so so'i nad babs dang bstun pa'i phan byed kyi me tog dang sman sogs mang ba gtong lugs bya/ de gnyis bre gang gi tshod tsam la zhib phul gang btab pa 'dam thag legs par byas te ril bu kham tshig tsam sgril la ril chags dang grib skam bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi de nyid bsgrub pa ni/

gnas khang byi dor dang spos chus chag chag gdab/ ril bu rnams ka pā la'i nang du blugs la nyer mchod bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rang nyid phag mo'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs/ rang dang ril bu gnyis ka /swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ snang srid chos kun 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang*// rang nyid skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// spyan gsum cung zad zhi khro'i nyams dang ldan// phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa// bdud rtsi ril bus gang ba thugs kar 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pad nyi ro steng bzhugs// me dpung 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong na gsal// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gnas gsum 'thu gsum gyis mtshan par gsal gdab/ de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul thams cad spyan drangs/ ril bu phag mor gsal ba la thim par dmigs te/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa a mṛ ta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes brgya stong bzlas rjes ril bu lhar gsal ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ rang yi dam gyi bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ja chang gang rigs kyi bor tshad res phul te ril bu gnyis re khyur mid du gtang*/ dka' thub kyi zas la bsten dgos pa yin tshe/ thug pa sla sing ba bka' brgyud rin po ches gsungs pa ltar phul re gtang*/ dmigs pa ni rtsa stong phrag bdun (327)cu rtsa gnyis/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ste bde stong lhan skyes ye shes g.yo med kyi rang mdangs 'gags med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni spyi bor bla ma kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang yab yum bskyed la/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ /gnas mchog 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mchog dpal mo chos sding chos grwa ru// kun mkhyen phyogs las rnam rgyal la=

/gnas mchog sham po gangs kyi ra ba ru// mi nyag rin chen rgyal ba la= /gnas mchog gsang phu ne'u thang yang steng du// mtshungs med ras ston chos rje la= /gnas mchog ri khrod yangs pa'i dgon pa ru// bya btang kun mkhyen chos mdzad la= /gnas mchog zab bu lung gi dgon pa ru// grub chen ba lu'i me tog la= /gnas mchog bkra shis dpal gyi dgon pa ru// 'dren mchog sangs rgyas brtson 'grus la= /gnas mchog bye tshags dben pa'i ri khrod du// rje btsun ratna'i mtshan can la= /gnas mchog 'on phu dkar gyi ri khrod du// rje btsun dpal ldan grags pa la= /gnas mchog shel dkar cog bu'i pho brang du// 'gro mgon lcog gra yab sras la= /gnas mchog thub bstan chos 'khor chos grwa ru// skyabs mchog 'jam dbyangs dga' ba la= /gnas mchog lha rtse bla ma'i gdan sa ru// mnyam med rin chen bzang po la= /gnas mchog gar bzhugs dag pa'i pho brang du// skyabs mgon dge legs rgyal mtshan la= /gnas mchog dga' ldan lha rtse'i pho brang du// 'dren mchog 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la= /gnas mchog byang chub sbyor lam pho brang du// skal bzang rin chen rnam rgyal la= /gnas mchog mkha' spyod bsam 'grub chos lding du// chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mo la= /gnas mchog sbyor rtse chos kyi pho brang du// kun mkhyen tshul khrims rdo rje la= /gnas mchog spyi (328)gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /gnas mchog rang lus rgyal ba'i pho brang du// rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la= /gnas mchog dag snang phyogs med gzhal yas su// mched grogs chos mdzad thams cad la= /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'di blo yis thongs par= /bde drod lus la 'bar bar= /stong nyid snying rje 'byongs par= /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par= /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje phag mo'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/ces gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsams te/ dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug sogs dang*/ bsngo smon rnams phyag chen gsol 'debs kyi rjes ltar song rjes/ rang nyid phag mo'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ rtsa bug stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis byang sems bdud rtsis gang bar dmigs te rlung bum can gang lcogs re 'dzin/ thun mtshams thams cad du rlung phyag la brtson pa dang*/ lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor sogs la 'bad/ ltog bgegs bsal phyir nam mkha' zas su za ba'i dmigs pa ni 'og rlung cung zad bsdam/ hūm̐ zhes pas steng rlung drag tu rngubs pa'i nam mkha' sngo 'dur gyis zhu nas sna bug nas drangs khong du mid par bsam/ gsum pa rjes phan yon dang dam tshig sogs rde'u dang mtshungs/ nyin re thun bzhi'i rim pas zhag bdun bsten no// ril bu lhag byung tshe rjes su gtong rgyu chog pas snod ko khug sogs rlung mi shor pa'i nang la blugs te tshags bya'o// me tog bcud len gyi gdams pa rdzogs so/// zhes pa 'di yang rta lo dbyar zla'i tha chung gi tshes nang chos dbyings dpal ldan/ 'jigs bral bstan skyong*/ skal bzang blo gros gsum nas mtshams (329)bcad kyis bcud len nyams su len pa'i skabs chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mos gong ma'i phyag bzhes mthong brgyud ltar yi ger spel ba'o// sarba dā maṅga lam/// /(330)
